checks.evidence: Three focused plus three wide collector queries; four current reused lanes explicitly scoped. Initial missing Groly resolved with exact snapshot and direct daily totals/PDF/offline comparison; kleerer and stack remain relevant counterexamples. No claim of exhaustive market absence.

All eight candidates use exact default-branch commit and hash-bound API metadata; archived, commit, push and observation timestamps are separated. Active denotes recent evidence only, not maintenance quality. Nutrition-label older activity is marked inactive.

All adoption statuses remain unknown. Stars/Forks, self-description, publishing, CI and arithmetic tests do not establish real use or commercial conversion; 2022 individual behaviors are explicitly limited.

Selected fixed upstream commit has directly readable MIT license. Other candidates including AGPL Groly/kleerer are reference only; stack API license remains UNKNOWN despite README MIT assertion. Final derivative audit remains required; unknown/needs_review security is not silently converted to acceptable.

Report names single toolkit, task documentation, spreadsheet and Groly as viable cheaper alternatives. integrate reuses an existing MIT core, not new medical algorithms. Independent task UI, examples, run path and fixed source attribution are minimum release requirements; extra SEO value is an unproven acquisition experiment with stopping/consolidation option.

Final report and all eight candidate/focused search hashes checked independently. Six-query assertion is now supported by both packaged snapshots; dates retain their real observations. Review identity differs from implementation owner, report contains candidate URLs and no private paths or credentials.

challenges.challenge: Current focused search surfaced Groly, whose official README already describes supplement daily totals, PDF sharing and offline mode; ignoring it would bias approval toward building.
challenges.resolution: Final report and manifest now include collector snapshot commit f86a9b7ced93047f2dc3210a77be6293e315c7c9, actual capabilities, AGPL and unknown adoption/security. Its accounts, SQLite and Docker differ from the stated account-free static module constraint. Existing functionality is acknowledged rather than claimed absent.

challenges.challenge: Three repositories could be thin title copies of an already working eight-tool project and add maintenance without incremental traffic.
challenges.resolution: Approval is bounded integrate experimentation: fixed MIT core, truly focused runnable task demos, distinct examples/questions and per-project referrals. Report explicitly does not promise ranking/citation or algorithm novelty; one toolkit and docs are viable alternatives. Implementation and release QA must reject copied eight-task UI with only name changes.

challenges.challenge: Claiming six collector searches while distributing only a three-query snapshot made the final public evidence incomplete.
challenges.resolution: Each admission directory now includes both github-search.snapshot.json and github-search-focused.snapshot.json, three actual dated queries per batch. Official manifest binds the focused snapshot, while the retained wide snapshot supports the report assertion.

challenges.challenge: Offline and zero dependencies do not establish medical safety or complete software security.
challenges.resolution: Report prohibits clinical recommendations and health-data forwarding, keeps missing information unknown, retains final code/license/privacy and responsive acceptance requirements, and does not label software security audited. Gate pass allows creation only, not unverified release or medical advice.
